channel.title: Battery Alert Pro Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on battery alerts, laptop longevity, and protecting unsaved work.

item.title: How to Run a Batch Script When Your Battery Hits a Certain Percentage
item.description: Running a .bat when the battery drops below a set level is easy in PowerShell and a minefield of silent failures. The working version, plus the gotchas.

item.title: Windows Only Warns You at 10% Battery. Here's How to Get Warned Earlier
item.description: Windows warns at 20% and 10% battery, then can shut down at 5%. What the defaults mean, how to change them, and how to get an alert you cannot miss.

item.title: ADHD and Lost Work: Why Your Laptop Dying Is an Executive Function Problem
item.description: A surprise shutdown costs everyone a file. With ADHD it costs the momentum too. Why the standard advice fails, and what to change instead.

item.title: Best Battery Monitoring Software for Windows 11 (2026)
item.description: Windows power tools split into two categories: health telemetry, and alert-and-action tools. An honest look at what each is actually good for.

item.title: Charging Your Laptop to 100% Is Damaging Your Battery. Do This Instead
item.description: Modern lithium-ion cells are not ruined by a full charge. The real culprits are heat and time at 100%. What actually shortens battery life.
